messages:
Lena (partnerships): Quick dry run notes for tomorrow's marketplace cutover. Please confirm: embargo lift, partner analytics access, SI onboarding link, and hardware asset approvals.
Tom (eng): Dry run passed in staging at 03:40 UTC. Two items: CDN header mismatch for partner badges and a rate-limit rule on the listing API that needs a temporary override at cutover.
Mei (PR): Embargo planned 10:00 PT. Press kit is ready but waiting on high-res EdgeBoard photos from hardware partner. Need them by 18:00 PT or we'll substitute with lifestyle shots.
Diego (growth): Landing page A/B test variant B has partner badges stacked differently; prefer stacked for mobile. We'll flip to variant B at +10m post-launch if metrics stable.
Sana (legal): Confirmed trademark clearances for EdgeBoard & NimbusVM names. One caveat: the hardware partner's legal wants the exact trademark string "EdgeBoard TM" used in hero blurb. No edits.
Vik (si - NimbusSys): SI onboarding docs updated with SSO link and dataset templates. Can we get partner test accounts provisioned for NimbusSys by 07:30 PT? We need to run an integration smoke.
deploy-bot: deploy check: marketplace-ui -> canary at 05:50 UTC; tests: 124/124 passed.
Tom (eng): I'll provision three partner test accounts at 06:00 PT and ping Vik. Also will set the rate-limit override at 09:45 PT for 30 minutes.
Lena (partnerships): Partners: NimbusCloud confirmed analytics access. EdgeChip (hardware) requested a partner-specific dashboard; we agreed to share view-only analytics. EdgeChip to accept invite by EOD.
Mei (PR): Social copy drafted. Requesting final partner quote for headline from EdgeChip and a short technical blurb from NimbusSys. Deadlines: quotes in by 17:00 PT.
Diego (growth): CDN purge plan: purge at 09:55 PT, then set low TTL (30s) for 10 minutes. Also prewarm cache for partner assets at 09:50 PT.
Tom (eng): Prewarm done at 09:50 PT in staging. One note: badge sprite sheet had a 404 on one sprite; fixed and reuploaded at 09:05 PT.
Sana (legal): EdgeChip sent a preferred quote but flagged a confidentiality footnote. They want it removed before public use. If legal approves, we'll keep it private to partner spotlight blog.
Vik (si - NimbusSys): Integration smoke with our staging token shows embeddings endpoint returning 202 on first request; retry logic in our adapter works, but flagging it.
Tom (eng): That's expected: cold-start on the embedding worker. We have warmed pools for production cutover; first-request latency should be fine.
Mei (PR): Press embargo email scheduled 09:00 PT to press list with assets link. If EdgeChip photos arrive late, I'll include a placeholder "image forthcoming" and follow up.
Lena (partnerships): If EdgeChip doesn't accept analytics invite, we default to sending CSV snapshots daily. EdgeChip indicated preference for dashboard access though.
Diego (growth): Tracking pixels and UTM params confirmed in all partner outbound links. I'll validate in preflight at 09:40 PT.
Tom (eng): Rate-limit override in place at 09:45 PT. CDN purge at 09:55 PT completed. Landing page cache TTL set to 30s at 09:56 PT.
deploy-bot: deploy success: marketplace-ui -> production at 09:58 PT. (logs: /deploy/1768612345) :white_check_mark:
Mei (PR): Live at 10:00 PT — embargo lifted. Sent press follow-up. Two early pick-ups; clipping in PR tracker.
Vik (si - NimbusSys): NimbusSys integration green. Partner dashboard visible and read-only access working. Thanks for the quick provisioning.
EdgeChip (guest): Apologies for delay 40 photos uploaded at 17:20 PT and quote approved. We accepted dashboard invite.
Sana (legal): Confirmed EdgeChip quote attribution as provided. No further redlines.
Diego (growth): Variant B live on mobile. Early KPI: +8% CTR on partner badges in first 12 minutes. Monitoring.
Lena (partnerships): Post-launch tasks: 1) send partner summary email + analytics links (doing now); 2) schedule partner spotlight blog with EdgeChip next Wed; 3) log incident if any badge mismatches.
Tom (eng): Monitoring shows stable latencies, embeddings warm. Will keep rate-limit override for 20 more minutes then revert.
Mei (PR): Great work team. I'll keep press window open 10:002:00 PT. Please update thread with any partner asks.
Lena (partnerships): Closing this thread after I post the partnership launch note to the runbook. Thanks everyone :tada:
